retrieval_method: Direct HTTPS GET of each official FTMO page from the QuantMechanica VPS on 2026-09-04 between 02:10:47Z and 02:10:49Z, using Python urllib with User-Agent 'Mozilla/5.0'. For every request the status line, Content-Type, Content-Length, Last-Modified header, final URL after redirects and the SHA-256 of the raw response body were recorded, and the raw body was written to disk. The eight retained bodies are committed under docs/ops/evidence/ftmo_fetch_20260904/ and their SHA-256 values equal the response hashes recorded in this snapshot. Nine URLs were requested: the seven expected sources plus the two declared economic component sources; https://ftmo.com/en/trading-symbols/ returned HTTP 404 and no body. No other retrieval, no browser rendering, no third-party mirror and no cross-check beyond these responses took place. Every normalized claim was then searched for in the retained bodies; the outcome per claim is recorded verbatim in claim_reconfirmation_2026_09_04, including the two claims that could NOT be re-confirmed.
raw_response_note: This is the normalized, hash-bound rules identity. Unlike the 2026-09-02 snapshot, every response observation here is a real 2026-09-04 measurement and the raw bodies are retained in-repository. The Last-Modified header returned by ftmo.com equals the request time for every page, so it is a dynamic-response artefact and not a content vintage; last_modified_is_content_vintage is false for that reason. The repository file SHA-256 remains the durable snapshot identity.
vintage_binding_note: The rulepack's official_sources rows bind the snapshot vintage retrieved_at_utc 2026-09-04T02:10:47Z (retrieved_on 2026-09-04), which is the fetch-run timestamp and the exact per-source observation for six of the seven expected sources. ftmo_forbidden_practices_official was observed one second later at 2026-09-04T02:10:48Z; its exact per-source value is recorded in this snapshot's sources array and is not rounded away.

claim_reconfirmation_summary.method: Each claim value and its surrounding rule wording were searched for in the retained 2026-09-04 bodies. RE_CONFIRMED means the quoted text was found in the named body; match_basis states whether the snapshot value is the literal page value or this repository's normalization of the quoted wording. QUOTE CHECK: 27 of the 28 RE_CONFIRMED quotes were machine-checked as literal substrings of the body named in their own row (matched against the raw response bytes, the HTML-unescaped bytes, or the tag-stripped whitespace-collapsed page text). The single exception is usd_100000_2_step_list_price_usd, whose evidence_quote is abridged with explicit "..." elisions and is therefore not a literal substring; its individual fragments were machine-checked instead and are listed in that row. PAGE CHECK: 25 of the 28 were re-confirmed on the page named by their own hash-pinned claim_provenance. Three (account_balance_increase_percent, minimum_months_between_scaleups, scaled_reward_split_percent) declare claim_provenance ftmo_economic_terms_official but were machine-checked as ABSENT from that body and PRESENT in the retained ftmo_scaling_plan_official body, a genuine official FTMO page that is NOT one of the seven expected source ids and is not a declared source record here. Four further rows name ftmo_2_step_challenge_official against a claim_provenance of ftmo_economic_terms_official; those two source records share the identical url https://ftmo.com/en/2-step-challenge/, so they count as re-confirmed on the declared provenance page. CARRIED_OVER means the value was NOT found on 2026-09-04 and is reproduced unchanged from the earlier snapshots; it is not a re-confirmation.
